digest.component_or_area: code-review gate model routing / LLM runner
propositions: code-review.yaml declares a model CLASS on five LLM-calling steps, but every declaration is silently ignored at runtime; all calls execute on the single resolved cfg.model
PydanticAIRunner.run discards req.config and resolves the model from self._config, causing per-step model declarations delivered by RunnerAgentStep to be ignored downstream
usage_log lacks per-step attribution, recording only the prompt op name without step id, making it impossible to distinguish which step produced which call or whether declarations were honoured
the fix requires threading step identity and declared class token through to the record point via ContextVar, substituting req.config.model into a copy of the runner's floor config before resolution
the same root cause breaks four per-call model overrides in plan-review (verifier sub-calls and prerequisite escalation ladder) that were also unintentionally ineffective
